items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 11 at 1:40AM EDT until October 12 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding during high tide.

* WHERE...Mainland Monroe, Coastal Broward County, Coastal Palm
Beach County, Coastal Collier County, Coastal Miami Dade County
and Far South Miami-Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
